integrity: The cube hexagon probability is acknowledged as established prior art, not claimed as independently new. The retained claim is the curved tricylinder switching-arc classification and general finite elementary central-section area formula, with an exact known numerical probability arising from a proved chamber correspondence.
scientific_limitations: Generic central planes of the equal-radius orthogonal infinite-cylinder intersection only; degeneracies have measure zero; no area distribution, extremal area, or translated-plane claim. Numerical checks are finite. The older specialist Moore and Angell–Moore full texts were not accessible and could contain equivalent assertions.
title: Exact central-section area and six/eight-arc law of the orthogonal tricylinder
